crossRefs.note: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come…
That night, Yahweh’s angel went out, and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished…
“So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…
This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come…
This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says Yahweh, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in…
so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with…
You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink, and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come…
For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals, which made them afraid…
Therefore as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon…
This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh…

translations.web: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.
translations.bsb: In the evening, there is sudden terror! Before morning, they are no more! This is the portion of those who loot us and the lot of those who plunder us.
translations.kjv: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob
translations.asv: At eventide, behold, terror; and before the morning they are not. This is the portion of them that despoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
